implementation details.

demonstrate the issue's externally observable behavior, and the fix pass must
demonstrate its correction. APIs used by the test must already exist at the
parent unless the issue is explicitly about a newly supported input to an
existing API.

the blocker briefly and stop; never fabricate a passing result.

- Prefix all version headings in `CHANGES.md` with "Version " (e.g., `## Version 26.3.1`) so that MyST-Parser generates stable, meaningful anchor IDs (like `#version-2631`) instead of the current generic auto-incremented ones (`#id1`, `#id2`, etc.) that shift with every release

- Update `scripts/check_version_in_basics_example.py` and `scripts/check_pre_commit_rev_in_example.py` to strip the "Version " prefix when extracting version numbers from changelog headers

Closes #4344
